title: Snatcher
overview:
Orders! Complete the Snatcher Disposal in Neo Kobe City.

"Snatcher," the cyberpunk adventure game masterpiece whose name lives on in gaming history, makes its long-awaited return on the Sega Saturn. Set in the near-future Neo Kobe City, a fierce deadly struggle between Snatchers and Junkers has now begun. Solve the mysterious incidents that occur one after another and corner the Snatchers! Neo Kobe City... in this town, letting your guard down is forbidden.

指令!ネオ・コウベ・シティのSNATCHER処理を完遂せよ。

ゲーム史にその名を残す、サイバーパンク・アドベンチャーゲームの傑作「スナッチャー」、セガサターンに待望の復活。近未来のネオ・コウベ・シティを舞台に、スナッチャーとジャンカーの壮絶な死闘が今始まった。次々と起こる怪事件を解決し、スナッチャーを追いつめろ!ネオ・コウベ・シティ・・・この街で油断は禁物だ。
